subsystems.name: Model architecture
subsystems.role: the mathematical structure that turns input into prediction — today a stack of transformer blocks.
parts: state-space or recurrent layers for long context

subsystems.name: Training infrastructure
subsystems.role: the cluster that makes learning possible at all.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: supplies the experience the model learns from.

subsystems.name: Learning and adaptation
subsystems.role: the objectives that shape raw text prediction into useful behaviour.
parts: reinforcement learning from human or AI feedback

subsystems.name: Inference and agent harness
subsystems.role: lets a trained model act over time rather than answer one prompt.

subsystems.name: Evaluation
subsystems.role: measures whether capability is genuinely general, not just benchmark-shaped.

subsystems.name: Alignment and control
subsystems.role: keeps a capable system doing what operators intend.

buildSteps.title: Define the capability target
buildSteps.detail: Write down what 'general' means for this system — which task families, how autonomously, over what time horizon — and build an evaluation suite before training starts, so progress is measurable.

buildSteps.title: Build the compute cluster
buildSteps.detail: Assemble tens of thousands of accelerators wired with fast interconnects, with power and cooling sized for continuous training. Current clusters draw hundreds of megawatts.

buildSteps.title: Curate the training data
buildSteps.detail: Collect text, images, audio and code; filter spam and duplicated material; label provenance; and top up with synthetic data generated by earlier models.

buildSteps.title: Pre-train the base model
buildSteps.detail: Train on next-token or masked prediction for weeks or months, sharding the model across the cluster and restarting from checkpoints when hardware fails.

buildSteps.title: Post-train for useful behaviour
buildSteps.detail: Fine-tune on demonstrations, then optimise with reinforcement learning against reward models or verifiable task outcomes to favour reasoning and instruction-following.

buildSteps.title: Add memory and continual learning
buildSteps.detail: Give the system retrievable long-term memory and an update mechanism so it accumulates skill from experience without forgetting earlier skills — the step no current system does reliably.

buildSteps.title: Wrap it in an agent harness
buildSteps.detail: Connect planning, tool use and a sandboxed workspace so the model can attempt multi-step tasks, observe results and correct itself.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate and red-team
buildSteps.detail: Run held-out and novel tests, adversarial probing and interpretability checks; failures feed back into data, objectives and safeguards.

buildSteps.title: Deploy under oversight
buildSteps.detail: Release with monitoring, staged access and shutdown authority, expanding autonomy only as evaluations justify it.

prerequisites.why: training runs scale with compute, and frontier clusters are already built and operating.

prerequisites.tech: Gradient-based deep learning and scaling laws
prerequisites.why: these are the methods that turned bigger models into measurably broader capability.
general capability needs experience of many domains and modalities, not one narrow corpus.
today's models are frozen after training, so they cannot keep learning on the job.
benchmarks saturate and leak, so nobody can currently certify how general a system is.
current techniques work at today's capability levels but are not proven to hold for much stronger systems.

pathway.milestone: frontier language and multimodal models that handle many tasks but fail unpredictably
pathway.unlocks: broad, cheap automation of well-specified cognitive work.

pathway.milestone: agentic systems that complete hours-long tasks with tools and memory
pathway.unlocks: automation of multi-step workflows such as research, coding and administration.

pathway.milestone: systems that learn continuously from their own experience
pathway.unlocks: rapid self-improvement and adaptation to new domains without retraining.

pathway.milestone: general autonomous systems operating under verifiable oversight
pathway.unlocks: if achieved, machine labour across most intellectual tasks — with unresolved questions of control, accountability and economic disruption.
